Who We Are

Born in Chennai.
Built for the World.

Vaultackie is a bold new technology company headquartered in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with deep roots in Dharmapuri. We were founded on a single conviction — that great software has the power to transform businesses, elevate lives, and rewrite what's possible.

We are not just another IT firm. Vaultackie is a thinking engine — a collective of engineers, designers, researchers, and strategists who thrive at the intersection of human creativity and machine intelligence. From crafting sleek mobile applications to deploying enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure, we build with precision and purpose.

As a rising force in India's tech ecosystem, we believe the next great technological breakthroughs won't just emerge from Silicon Valley — they'll emerge from determined minds right here in Tamil Nadu. We're building Vaultackie to prove exactly that.

AI & ML Cloud Native Full-Stack Dev Cybersecurity Product Design IoT Systems

What We Build

Solutions that Scale

From concept to deployment, we craft technology that performs under pressure and grows with your ambition.

🧠

AI & Machine Learning

We design and deploy intelligent systems — from natural language interfaces and recommendation engines to predictive analytics and computer vision solutions that learn as they operate.

☁️

Cloud Infrastructure

Architect resilient, scalable cloud environments on AWS, Azure, and GCP. We handle migration, DevOps pipelines, containerization, and multi-region reliability engineering.

📱

Mobile & Web Development

End-to-end product engineering for iOS, Android, and the web. We build performant, beautiful applications that users genuinely love to open every single day.

🔐

Cybersecurity

Protect your digital assets with penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, zero-trust architecture design, and real-time threat monitoring tailored to your stack.

🌐

Digital Transformation

We partner with enterprises to reimagine legacy workflows, digitise operations, and create a connected technology ecosystem that drives measurable ROI.

📊

Data Engineering & Analytics

Turn raw data into strategic advantage. We build data lakes, pipelines, dashboards, and BI tools that give your team real-time insight and decision confidence.

Our Philosophy

Driven by Values,
Built on Vision

Relentless Innovation

We challenge the status quo daily — every sprint, every line of code, every design decision is an opportunity to push the frontier further.

People First

Technology exists to serve humans. We build with empathy and design every experience with the end user at the very center of our thinking.

Transparent Collaboration

We work as partners, not vendors. Open communication, honest timelines, and shared ownership of outcomes define every engagement.

Engineering Excellence

Good enough is never good enough at Vaultackie. We hold every build to the highest standards of quality, security, and performance.

🚀 Our Vision for 2030

Vaultackie envisions a world where every business — regardless of scale — has access to enterprise-grade technology. We are building a future where intelligent software bridges the gap between aspiration and execution.

Our roadmap takes us from Chennai to every tech hub on the planet. Within the decade, we aim to be among India's most globally recognised product and services technology companies, known not just for what we build — but for how we build it.

The journey from Dharmapuri to the world begins now. Join us.

Leadership

Vignesh
Sivajayam

Founder & Chief Executive Officer

Vignesh Sivajayam is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Vaultackie, an emerging technology enterprise dedicated to architecting next-generation digital solutions. Blending a rigorous foundation in corporate finance — rooted in extensive Procure-to-Pay (P2P) operations and compliance auditing — with a deep passion for advanced software architecture, Vignesh leads Vaultackie with a vision to engineer scalable, future-ready ecosystems.

Hailing from Tamil Nadu, his leadership philosophy champions a synthesis of operational efficiency and relentless innovation. By integrating sophisticated backend logic with minimalist, high-impact design aesthetics, Vignesh is positioning Vaultackie at the intersection of technological advancement and sustainable business growth. He envisions a digital landscape where robust financial principles meet cutting-edge, decentralized technology.

"The next great tech revolution won't emerge from a single valley — it will emerge from every determined mind that dares to build something the world hasn't seen yet."
